title: Local For Ever
style: Latin boom-bap rap with Nicaraguan pride, swung congas, live brass punches, and a steady head-nod groove; verse rides sparse drums, bass, and trumpet stabs, pre-chorus opens with hand percussion and call-and-response, chorus hits with full big-band hits and chant doubles. Lead male vocal stays close-mic and gritty, with stacked ad-libs, short delay throws on key phrases, and gang echoes on the hook. Maraca flicks, rim clicks, and a rising horn swell bridge into the chorus; mix is bright, punchy, and wide with a warm live-room feel., big band, rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey, listen close, I came with the truth,
Raffa on the mic, bringing fire and proof.
Nicaragua in my chest, Volcán under skin,
Old roads, hard days, still I’m built to win.

From the lake to the block, from dust to the drum,
Every scar got a story, every mile got some.
I seen storms come hard, I seen doors swing shut,
Still I plant my feet and I never fold up.

He said, “local for ever,” that line hit right,
Like the whole old country kept me up all night.
And I carry that weight like a flag in the air,
If you know where you’re from, you can get anywhere.

[Pre-Chorus]
Been through it all,
Still I stand tall.
Ready for anything,
I don’t fear the fall.

Hear it in my step,
Feel it in my name,
Nicaragua alive,
And I bring that flame.

[Chorus]
Local for ever
Nicaragua forever
Been through it all
And ready for anything

Music will set you free
Music will set you free
Corey, believe me
Music will set you free

[Verse 2]
Raffa said, “Corey,” like he knew my fight,
Like he saw my shadow and he blessed my light.
Every bridge I crossed had a crack in it first,
Still I crossed that water with a hunger and thirst.

Markets full of voices, sun on the stone,
Every name I loved kept me from feeling alone.
I don’t need a crown, I don’t need a throne,
Just a beat in my blood and a road to my home.

“Me is Corey,” yeah, that’s how I came,
Same heart, same hurt, same fire, same name.
And if the night gets loud and the pressure climbs,
I’m gonna dance through the grit like I own my time.

[Pre-Chorus]
Been through it all,
Still I stand tall.
Ready for anything,
I don’t fear the fall.

Hear it in my step,
Feel it in my name,
Nicaragua alive,
And I bring that flame.

[Chorus]
Local for ever
Nicaragua forever
Been through it all
And ready for anything

Music will set you free
Music will set you free
Corey, believe me
Music will set you free

[Bridge]
When the dust comes down, I’m still here,
With the old land calling, loud and clear.
No chain, no fear, just a beating drum,
From the roots of the map where I come from.

[Final Chorus]
Local for ever
Nicaragua forever
Been through it all
And ready for anything

Music will set you free
Music will set you free
Corey, believe me
Music will set you free
